name: TreeScope (agri/forestry LiDAR mapping)
notes_short: Agri/forestry mapping dataset (TreeScope): UAV flights + ground sensor platform; LiDAR + RGB-D + thermal + GNSS/IMU. License: CC BY-NC-SA 4.0 (see TreeScope site).

name: ARD-VO (Vineyards & Olive Groves)
notes_short: ARD-VO dataset for visual odometry in vineyards & olive groves (UGV). License: CC BY-NC-SA 3.0. Repo includes links to download data.

name: CitrusFarm Dataset
notes_short: Citrus-Farm Dataset (UGV) in citrus groves: LiDAR + RGB/stereo + thermal + GNSS/IMU.

name: Rosario Dataset v2
notes_short: Rosario Dataset v2: UGV runs in a soybean plantation; RealSense D435i (RGB+IR/depth), multiple IMUs, GNSS, wheel/motor odom; optional ground-truth add-on. License not stated on landing page.

name: Hilti SLAM Challenge 2023 (handheld runs)
notes_short: Hilti SLAM Challenge Dataset 2023 — handheld runs (construction/industrial scenes). Licensed CC BY-NC-SA 3.0.

name: Hilti SLAM Challenge 2023 (robot runs)
notes_short: Hilti SLAM Challenge Dataset 2023 — robot runs (construction/industrial scenes). Licensed CC BY-NC-SA 3.0.

name: Boreal Forest Fire (UAV-collected wildfire detection & smoke segmentation)
notes_short: Boreal Forest Fire dataset: UAV imagery with wildfire/smoke annotations from Finnish boreal forests (hosted on Fairdata/Etsin).

name: FLAME dataset (pile burn detection using drones)
notes_short: FLAME dataset (pile-burn): UAV videos + thermal heatmaps; published via IEEE DataPort under CC BY 4.0.

name: FireMan-UAV-RGBT (wildfire monitoring, Finland)
notes_short: FireMan-UAV-RGBT: UAV-captured RGB + thermal videos from controlled burns (Finland). Zenodo record indicates CC BY 4.0.

name: WIT-UAS Dataset (Wildland-fire Infrared Thermal)
notes_short: WIT-UAS: aerial IR thermal dataset for wildland fire / crew-asset detection. License not clearly stated in repo.

name: FIRESENSE database (videos flame & smoke detection)
notes_short: FIRESENSE: annotated videos for flame/smoke detection (Zenodo). License: CC BY 4.0.

name: Furg-Fire Dataset (non-stationary video fire detection)
notes_short: Furg-Fire dataset: non-stationary video fire detection benchmark. GitHub indicates CC0-1.0.

name: HPWREN Fire Ignition Library (FIgLib)
notes_short: WIFIRE/HPWREN Fire Ignition Library; license not specified on portal.

name: DeeperSense FLC+FLS (Red Sea / Eilat)
notes_short: Zenodo record; Forward-Looking Camera (FLC) + Forward-Looking Sonar (FLS).

name: MOSAiC Under-ice ROV screenshots
notes_short: MOSAiC under-ice ROV screenshots (PANGAEA DOI).

name: NOAA Ocean Exploration Video Portal (ROV dives)
notes_short: Portal sometimes rate-limited; NOAA says portal videos are public domain (credit requested).

name: Shipwreck-Dataset (LIRMM)
notes_short: Academic use only per dataset page; download via LIRMM GitLab.

name: UWslamdataset
notes_short: Underwater SLAM dataset (diver + ROV); CC0 stated in repo.

name: ConSLAM (construction dataset for SLAM)
notes_short: GitHub repo provides dataset link (external). License: academic use only, all rights reserved.

name: Google Cartographer backpack (Deutsches Museum)
notes_short: Cartographer backpack dataset page; data links are large bag files (tool fetch may fail).

name: Hilti SLAM Challenge Dataset 2023
notes_short: Hilti SLAM Challenge dataset page states CC BY-NC-SA 3.0.

name: Echord++ 'Into the dirt' (Barcelona sewers)
notes_short: SIAR ground robot + ARSI aerial platform; ROS bags; CC BY-NC-SA 3.0 on site.

name: WHU-PA3D (planetary analogue)
notes_short: ISPRS paper PDF is accessible; dataset download not clearly linked (likely request authors).

name: Aerial inspection dataset (mesh_based_mapping)
notes_short: Repo includes code + dataset links; license text says GPLv3 for research purposes; check dependencies (Fade2D).

name: DTU wind turbine inspection images (Nordtank)
notes_short: Mendeley Data. UAV imagery of a wind turbine (DTU). License CC BY-NC 3.0.

name: Fogo UAV survey (Chã das Caldeiras)
notes_short: Zenodo: DSM + orthomosaics of Chã das Caldeiras lava fields (Fogo, Dec 2016). Keywords include point cloud; large downloads.

name: Lascar volcano products
notes_short: Zenodo: UAV+Pléiades products at Lascar volcano; includes LAS point clouds and thermal orthomosaics (GeoTIFF).

name: Shiveluch volcano photogrammetry
notes_short: GFZ Data Services / panmetaworks: optical satellite + helicopter aerial images, DEM, point clouds, thermal infrared for Shiveluch volcano.

name: BASEPROD
notes_short: BASEPROD (ESA): rover sensor dataset + drone mapping products + LIBS and weather; Bardenas Reales semi-desert analogue site.

name: CERBERUS SubT Finals (Louisville Mega Cavern)
notes_short: CERBERUS (DARPA SubT): dataset links for stereo images + synchronized IMU/LiDAR and ground-truth structure (ETH research collection).

name: DARPA SubT Urban Circuit reference dataset
notes_short: DARPA SubT Tunnel/Urban reference datasets: PackBot/Husky with Ouster OS1-64 + Multisense SL (stereo+lidar) + CO2; rosbags hosted on AWS S3.

name: GEODE dataset (Metro_Tunnels_Tunneling etc.)
notes_short: GEODE: multi-LiDAR (VLP-16 / OS1-64 / Livox AVIA) + stereo cameras + Xsens IMU; data provided as ROS1 bags via Google Drive / Baidu.

name: Mars 2020 Perseverance (Mastcam-Z/Navcam/Hazcam bundles)
notes_short: NASA PDS bundle page for Mars 2020 Mastcam-Z (Perseverance): EDR/RDR data products; DOI listed on PDS.

name: Ballast Water Tank Dataset (NTNU)
notes_short: Ballast Water Tank Dataset: collected in ballast tanks (3 vessels) with aerial robot RMF-Owl and handheld 'Mjolnir'; sensors include Ouster OS0-64, FLIR Blackfly S cameras, Vectornav VN100 IMU, TI radar.

name: Buried pipes dataset (Sheffield ORDA)
notes_short: ORDA link was blocked by the checker tool (likely anti-bot). Dataset appears to be LiDAR + camera with synchronization for buried pipe inspection; please verify access manually.

name: FusionPortableV2
notes_short: FusionPortable V2: multi-sensor dataset (rosbags) + ground-truth maps/poses + calibration; sensors include LiDAR, stereo, event camera, IMU, GNSS/INS and encoders. Data page: /fusionportable_v2_data/ (Google Drive).

name: ICE-LAPSE Antarctic benthic imagery
notes_short: Time-lapse benthic imagery (stationary underwater observing system).

name: LROC NAC/WAC (Lunar Reconnaissance Orbiter)
notes_short: PDS LROC EDR: NAC (panchro) + WAC (color). Public domain (US).

name: MIN3D (Project Riese WWII, Walim)
notes_short: Multi-sensor UGV mapping: monocular/stereo/thermal + 2 LiDAR + 3 IMU; GT pointclouds via survey TLS.

name: Mine Mapping Dataset (shaft -300m)
notes_short: Mine shaft mapping rosbags (Velodyne + Livox + IMU). No explicit license found on the dataset pages/repo.

name: MineInsight (demining / landmine detection)
notes_short: Demining dataset (Husky A200 + UR5e). Sensors: RGB/mono/VIS-SWIR/LWIR + LiDAR.

name: Morocco2018 (MADMAX / ARCHES)
notes_short: MADMAX: Mars-analogue navigation experiments. Free for academic use; registration required; full rosbags on request.

name: NeBula Odometry Dataset
notes_short: Extreme underground odometry/SLAM datasets used by Team CoSTAR (DARPA SubT).

name: OSIRIS-REx Bennu (OCAMS + OLA)
notes_short: PDS SBN mission page aggregating OCAMS (images) + OLA (laser altimeter) bundles. Public domain (US).

name: Oxford RobotCar Dataset
notes_short: Multi-sensor car dataset (Oxford). Non-commercial ShareAlike license.

name: Oxford Spires Dataset
notes_short: Handheld/backpack dataset around Oxford ‘dreaming spires’ buildings (Ouster LiDAR + 360 imagery + IMU/GNSS).

name: RoboCup ROSbag dataset (TIAGo)
notes_short: Zenodo: ROSbag recordings from RoboCup (TIAGo). Metadata sparse on Zenodo page.

name: SEW Multimodal AMR dataset 2025
notes_short: SEW AMR dataset: RGB+thermal + radar/ultrasonic + ToF point clouds + laser scanner ranges. ShareAlike.

name: SubT environment dataset (LTU) + 360
notes_short: DARPA SubT env. dataset (CoSTAR/LTU): LiDAR + RealSense RGB-D + thermal + UWB (+ IMU) and 360 video.

name: TIERS multi-lidar dataset (enhanced)
notes_short: Multi-LiDAR dataset repo (MIT). Dataset downloads are linked from the repo (external hosting).

name: TartanGround (simulation)
notes_short: TartanGround (simulation): stereo RGB + depth/flow/segm + LiDAR + IMU + GT poses.

name: UAS competition rosbags (maze / obstacle)
environment: PX4-Gazebo sim + real flights (PURT, Indiana, US)
notes_short: ROSbag dataset for UAV Chase + Maze challenges (sim-to-real). Paper: PMC12410569 (CC BY-NC 4.0).

name: UMA-SAR dataset
notes_short: UMA-SAR: logs in simulated disaster environments; site states for research use (property of UMA).

name: Underground Mining Shaft Survey (multi-LiDAR+IMU)
notes_short: Mine Mapping Dataset: vertical mine-shaft survey with ROSbags, multi-LiDAR/IMU and reference laser scans.

name: WRC sewer inspection image library
notes_short: WRC article points to a free-to-download sewer image library hosted on the Spring platform; portal access/terms unclear.

name: UPO 'Into the smoke' (NIx)
notes_short: NIx tracked robot in smoke-filled underground indoor scenario. Sensors: RGB cams + Ouster LiDAR + mmWave RADAR (+ odom/TF, GT).

name: FLOBOT perception dataset
notes_short: FLOBOT floor-scrubber ROSbags: 3D LiDAR + 2x RGB-D + stereo + IMU/encoders, with annotations (pedestrian/dirt/object).

name: FieldSAFE (tractor agriculture dataset)
notes_short: FieldSAFE ROSbags (tractor): stereo + thermal + 360 + LiDAR + RADAR + GNSS/IMU, with obstacle GT (geo coords).

name: HiRISE stereo pairs (MRO)
notes_short: HiRISE PDS archive directory (MRO) with downloadable image products (incl. stereo coverage).

name: InspecSafe-V1
notes_short: InspecSafe-V1 on Hugging Face (MIT).

name: M2DGR dataset
notes_short: Moins 'infréquentable' mais très riche

name: Underwater caves dataset (UdG/CIRS)
notes_short: AUV en grottes sous-marines (2013) : 2 sonars MSIS + DVL + 2 IMU + capteur de profondeur + caméra verticale; rosbags + exports texte sur Zenodo.

name: C3VD (Colonoscopy 3D Video Dataset)
notes_short: Vidéos de colonoscopie + vérités terrain par frame (depth/normals/flow/occlusion/pose/mesh). La page C3VDv2 indique une licence CC BY 4.0 couvrant le site/dataset.

name: EndoSLAM Dataset
notes_short: Monde non rigide

name: Hamlyn Rectified Dataset
notes_short: Licence GPL sur HF (selon discussion)

name: Kvasir-Capsule
notes_short: Dataset images capsule endoscopique. Les Terms of Use indiquent un usage gratuit pour recherche/éducation, mais usage commercial uniquement sur demande (permission).

name: StereoMIS (da Vinci Xi)
notes_short: Dataset chirurgie robotisée (da Vinci Xi) sur Zenodo — licence CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

name: NTNU Underwater multi-camera visual-inertial dataset
notes_short: Dataset visuel-inertiel multi-caméras en milieu sous-marin (NTNU ARL) — repo GitHub (BSD-3-Clause).

name: DARPA SubT Tunnel Circuit reference dataset
notes_short: Référence DARPA SubT (Tunnel/Urban circuits). Fichiers listés via S3 (rosbags, etc.) — la licence n’est pas explicitement indiquée dans le repo.

name: MARBLE SubT Finals (Kentucky Mega Cavern)
notes_short: Très bon candidat 'méga-grotte' ; rosbags + vidéos

name: Chilean Underground Mine Dataset (AMTC)
notes_short: Dataset mine (Husky A200) : stéréo (Bumblebee XB3), lidar 3D Riegl VZ-400, radar 2D FMCW, encodeurs; téléchargement via FTP + rosbags.

name: Leica BLK ARC sample datasets (Spot/Trolley SLAM)
notes_short: Page Leica BLK ARC 'dataset downloads' visible, mais liens de téléchargement pas clairement exposés (probable login/JS).

name: Robotic Lava Tube Mapping (4TU/TU Delft)
notes_short: Terrestrial lava-tube analogue (Sicily) for Rhizome 2.0/Mars habitat research; includes floor photos, phone 3D scans (OBJ), LiDAR point clouds, FPV video, SLAM maps/posegraphs, and synced temperature/humidity/light logs.

name: SubSurfaceGeoRobo (mine d'argent Freiberg)
notes_short: Collected Sept 2024 in Freiberg silver mine (Germany) with a UGV; radars, 3D LiDAR, RGB+depth cameras, IMU, and 2D laser scanners in bag files; includes joint sensor calibration and a RIEGL ground-truth point cloud (<2 mm accuracy).

name: Tajogaite volcano drone dataset (La Palma 2021)
notes_short: Tajogaite/Cumbre Vieja (La Palma) 2021: DJI drone surveys (orthos/DEMs), time‑lapse camera records, and COSMO‑SkyMed SAR amplitude data; ~54 GB.

name: GOOSE / GOOSE-Ex (inclut Spot)
notes_short: GOOSE (German Outdoor & Offroad) dataset/spec: annotated LiDAR point clouds + pixel-wise RGB/NIR segmentation masks + accurate localization; multi-platform (MuCAR-3 off-road vehicle, ALICE, Spot; additional excavator data via GOOSE‑Ex).

name: Kimera-Multi-Data (Campus Tunnels etc.)
notes_short: Multi-robot SLAM dataset on MIT campus with Clearpath Jackal rovers (Realsense D455 RGB‑D + Velodyne/Ouster LiDAR); Outdoor/Tunnels/Hybrid splits; compressed rosbags (rosbags via request form) + GT trajectories and reference point cloud (GPS + total-station-assisted LiDAR SLAM).

name: M2P2 (low-light multimodal off-road)
notes_short: M2P2: extreme low-light off-road dataset (rosbags) with thermal + event + stereo RGB, IMU/GPS, and LiDAR used for ground truth; hosted on GMU Dataverse (CC0).

name: NCLT (North Campus Long-Term)
notes_short: NCLT: long-term dataset collected by a Segway robot on the University of Michigan North Campus; omnidirectional imagery, 3D+planar LiDAR, GPS and proprioceptive sensors for odometry, plus ground-truth pose (distribution via Globus).
